title: You Don't Have a Right to Safe Drinking Water, US Court Rules
summary: A US court has ruled that citizens do not have a constitutional right to safe drinking water, a decision that has significant implications for environmental justice and public health policy in America.
problem_solved: The article reports on a court ruling that denies constitutional protection for safe drinking water access.
why_valuable: This ruling highlights a critical gap in US environmental law and could affect millions of Americans' access to clean water.
